evals.name: confluence-guide
evals.prompt: Velero 복구 가이드 하위 페이지로 작성해줘
evals.expected_output: Storage-format XHTML body drafted, and the parent page URL is asked for before creating since none was given. No em dash, en dash, middle dot, arrow shorthand, horizontal rules, or title emoji; overview states purpose and target reader; single path with alternatives collapsed to one line; bullets over tables; CLI steps as one sentence plus a code block; any image uses centered storage markup at width 760; URLs wrapped on a keyword via <a href>.

evals.name: public-readme
evals.expected_output: English, one idea per bullet, keyword links, no company names, internal hosts, or internal systems, one line per paragraph with no hard wrap.

evals.name: shrink
evals.expected_output: Result is 25 to 35 percent of the original by wc -m; every heading kept in the same order; existing screenshots preserved; em dash, en dash, middle dot, and arrow shorthand removed; URLs wrapped on a keyword.

evals.name: github-issue
evals.prompt: upstream 저장소에 올릴 버그 리포트 GitHub 이슈 본문 작성해줘
evals.expected_output: English body with no backticks at all, no em dash, en dash, middle dot, or arrow shorthand; no company names, internal hosts, or internal systems; URLs wrapped on a keyword; HTTP status written as code plus reason.
